ENFORCEMENT DECREE OF THE ACT ON THE ESTABLISHMENT OF THE KOREA NATIONAL DEFENSE UNIVERSITY

Article 1 (Purpose)
The purpose of this Decree is to prescribe matters delegated by the Act on the Establishment of the Korea National Defense University and matters necessary for its enforcement. <Amended on October 19, 2009; February 3, 2015>

Article 2 (National Security Graduate School)
(1) The National Security Graduate School under Article 3 (1) of the Act on the Establishment of the Korea National Defense University (hereinafter referred to as the “Act”) shall teach academic disciplines concerning national security policies and military strategies. <Amended on October 19, 2009; February 3, 2015>
(2) The National Security Graduate School shall have an Academic Affairs Office; the head of that Office shall be appointed from among professors by the president of the Korea National Defense University (hereinafter referred to as the “University President”) upon recommendation by the dean of the Graduate School. <Amended on December 6, 2022>

Article 3 (National Defense Management Graduate School)
(1) The National Defense Management Graduate School under Article 3 (1) of the Act shall teach academic disciplines concerning the management of national defense resources, the management of information resources, and national defense science.
(2) The National Defense Management Graduate School shall have an Academic Affairs Office; the head of that Office shall be appointed from among professors by the University President upon recommendation by the dean of the Graduate School. <Amended on December 6, 2022>

Article 4 Deleted. <December 9, 2014>

Article 5 (Department of Job Training)
(1) The Department of Job Training under Article 3 (1) of the Act shall teach academic disciplines necessary for special courses determined by the Minister of National Defense.
(2) The director of the Department of Job Training shall be appointed by the University President from among Grade III or higher-ranking civilian military employees or professors; where appointed from among professors, the director's term of office shall be two years. <Amended on December 6, 2022>

Article 6 (Faculty Board, etc.)
(1) The subordinate organizations of the Korea National Defense University under Article 3 (2) of the Act shall be as follows: <Amended on February 3, 2015; December 6, 2022>
1. Faculty Board;
2. Planning and Coordination Office;
3. Administrative Support Department;
4. Office for External Cooperation;
5. International Peace Activity Center.
(2) The duties of the subordinate organizations under paragraph (1) shall be as follows: <Amended on February 3, 2015; December 6, 2022>
1. Faculty Board: Education at the Korea National Defense University and personnel affairs of professors, associate professors, and assistant professors (hereinafter referred to as “professors, etc.”), including their appointment and deployment;
2. Planning and Coordination Office: The University's development plans and the formulation, operation, and execution of its organization and budget;
3. Administrative Support Department: Personnel affairs, including appointment and deployment, of persons other than professors, etc., and logistical support, including procurement, supply, and transportation of military supplies;
4. Office for External Cooperation: Domestic and international exchange and cooperation and public relations activities of the University;
5. International Peace Activity Center: Education of persons involved in overseas deployments and policy research on military affairs in the field of international peace activities.
(3) The Minister of National Defense shall determine the division of duties and organization of the Faculty Board, Planning and Coordination Office, Administrative Support Department, Office for External Cooperation, and International Peace Activity Center; the University President shall determine matters necessary for their operation. <Amended on February 3, 2015; December 6, 2022>

Article 7 (Duration of Degree Courses, etc.)
Degree courses under Article 4 (2) of the Act shall consist of master's and doctoral degree courses; their duration shall be at least two years for a master's degree course and at least three years for a doctoral degree course. <Amended on September 12, 2001; October 23, 2007>

Article 8 (Scope of Institutions or Organizations)
“Other institutions or organizations prescribed by Presidential Decree” in the main clause of Article 5 of the Act means any of the following institutions or organizations:
1. Educational institutions and academic organizations;
2. Government-invested institutions or government-funded institutions;
3. Media organizations, including broadcasting companies, newspaper companies, or news agencies;
4. Economic or social organizations;
5. Enterprises.

Article 9 (Qualifications for Admission)
(1) Persons eligible for admission to the basic courses of the National Security Graduate School or National Defense Management Graduate School shall be any of the following: <Amended on June 12, 2006; December 6, 2022>
1. Active-duty officers who have graduated from the colleges of their respective armed services;
2. Grade IV or higher-ranking public officials or civilian military employees, or public officials in general service belonging to the Senior Civil Service;
3. Persons prescribed by Ordinance of the Ministry of National Defense from among executives of the institutions or organizations specified in the subparagraphs of Article 8.
(2) Deleted. <December 9, 2014>
(3) Persons eligible for admission to degree courses shall be any of the following: <Amended on October 19, 2009>
1. Officers, warrant officers, noncommissioned officers, and civilian military employees serving on active duty;
2. Public officials;
3. Executive officers or employees of the institutions or organizations specified in the subparagraphs of Article 8.
(4) In addition to the persons specified in paragraphs (1) and (3), the University President may, with the approval of the Minister of National Defense and within the authorized student quota, admit foreign military officers and other persons whom the University President deems it necessary to educate at the Korea National Defense University. <Amended on February 3, 2015>

Article 10 (Student Quota and Selection)
(1) Matters necessary concerning the quota, selection, and admission of students entering the Korea National Defense University shall be prescribed by Ordinance of the Ministry of National Defense. In such cases, the Minister of National Defense shall consult in advance with the Minister of Education regarding the quota for students entering degree courses. <Amended on January 29, 2001; February 29, 2008; March 23, 2013>
(2) The University President shall submit to the Minister of National Defense a list of persons admitted to degree courses within 30 days of their admission.

Article 11 (University President, etc.)
(1) The University President shall exercise overall control of academic affairs and direct and supervise the faculty and staff under the University President's authority. <Amended on July 2, 2019; December 6, 2022>
(2) The vice president of the Korea National Defense University shall assist the University President and act on the University President's behalf when the latter is unable to perform duties for unavoidable reasons.
(3) The deans of the National Security Graduate School and National Defense Management Graduate School shall, under the University President's direction, exercise overall control of academic affairs at the relevant graduate school and college, direct and supervise their faculty and staff, and guide students. <Amended on December 9, 2014; July 2, 2019; December 6, 2022>
(4) The dean of the Faculty Board shall exercise overall control of its affairs and assist the University President in education at the University and personnel affairs of professors, etc. <Amended on July 2, 2019>

Article 12 (Quota of Professors, etc.)
(1) The quota of professors and associate professors in charge of education in degree courses under Article 9 (1) of the Act shall be as specified in the attached Table.
(2) The Minister of National Defense shall determine the quota of military personnel and civilian military employees at the Korea National Defense University, excluding professors and associate professors under paragraph (1).

Article 13 (Qualifications of Professors, etc.)
Professors, etc. solely responsible for education in basic and special courses under Article 9 (2) of the Act shall be any of the following persons: <Amended on August 9, 2022>
1. Persons holding at least a master's degree in the relevant field who have worked for at least two years in a national defense policy department, including experience acquired before obtaining the degree;
2. Persons who have worked in the relevant field for at least two years and are recognized as possessing specialized knowledge and skills in the relevant practice;
3. Persons with extensive work experience in operational units whose primary mission is combat and in national defense policy departments, and at least two years' experience as instructors or teaching personnel at military educational institutions.

Article 13-2 (Appointment of Professors and Associate Professors)
(1) Pursuant to Article 9 (3) of the Act, the President of the Republic shall delegate to the Minister of National Defense the authority to appoint professors and associate professors in charge of education in degree courses.
(2) The University President shall recommend to the Minister of National Defense professors and associate professors to take charge of education in degree courses.

Article 14 (Research Institute for National Security Affairs)
(1) The Research Institute for National Security Affairs under Article 10 (1) of the Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Institute”) shall have a director, whose position shall be held concurrently by the University President: Provided, That, where deemed necessary, the Minister of National Defense may separately appoint a director from among general-level (將星級) officers or professors upon recommendation by the University President. <Amended on September 5, 2017>
(2) The director's term of office shall be two years: Provided, That where the University President concurrently serves as director, the term shall be the period during which that person serves as University President.
(3) The Institute shall have responsibility for the following matters:
1. Academic research on national security;
2. Research on national defense policies and military strategies;
3. Research on academic theories in each field of education at the Korea National Defense University;
4. Holding academic conferences relating to subparagraphs 1 and 2;
5. Exchange with domestic and foreign research institutes and collection of materials;
6. Issuance of publications;
7. Support and guidance for the research work of professors and students.
(4) The Institute shall have a Research Planning Office and such research centers as are necessary; the Minister of National Defense shall determine matters necessary for their division of duties and operation. <Amended on February 3, 2015>

Article 15 (Library)
(1) The library under Article 10 (1) of the Act shall have a director, appointed by the University President from among professors. <Amended on December 6, 2022>
(2) The director shall, under the University President's direction, exercise overall control of the library's affairs; the term of office shall be two years. <Amended on July 2, 2019>
(3) A reference room may be established and operated in the library to facilitate educational support at the Korea National Defense University.
(4) The Minister of National Defense shall determine matters necessary for the organization and division of duties of the library.

Article 16 Deleted. <December 9, 2014>

Article 17 (University Regulations)
(1) The University President shall establish university regulations with the approval of the Minister of National Defense.
(2) Before approving the regulations under paragraph (1), the Minister of National Defense shall consult with the Minister of Education regarding matters concerning degree courses. The same shall apply to amendments to such matters. <Amended on January 29, 2001; February 29, 2008; March 23, 2013>
(3) The university regulations shall include the following:
1. Semesters, number of instructional days, and leave of absence;
2. Admission and expulsion;
3. Duration of courses and maximum periods of enrollment;
4. Curricula;
5. Exchange of credits with other schools;
6. Academic reporting and conferment of degrees;
7. Academic assessment, awards, and disciplinary action;
8. Other matters necessary for the education and operation of the Korea National Defense University.

Article 18 (Committees)
(1) The Korea National Defense University shall have a Faculty Personnel Committee to deliberate on important personnel matters concerning professors, etc., and an Academic Affairs Deliberation Committee to deliberate on important matters concerning classes, majors, curricula, conferment of degrees, and other educational operations.
(2) Matters necessary for the composition and operation of each committee under paragraph (1) shall be prescribed by the university regulations.

Article 19 Deleted. <July 27, 2021>

Article 20 (Processing of Unique Identifying Information)
The University President may process data containing resident registration numbers under subparagraph 1 of Article 19 of the Enforcement Decree of the Personal Information Protection Act where unavoidable for performing affairs concerning the conferment of degrees under Article 7 of the Act.

ADDENDA <Presidential Decree No. 16626, December 28, 1999>
Article 1 (Enforcement Date) This Decree shall enter into force on January 1, 2000.
Article 2 (Repeal of Other Decrees) The Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Establishment of the National Defense Graduate School and the Decree on the Establishment of the National Defense Staff College are each repealed.
Article 3 (Transitional Measures concerning Graduates and Faculty and Staff of the National Defense Staff College)
(1) Persons who graduated from the National Defense Staff College before this Decree enters into force shall be deemed to have graduated from the Joint Staff College under this Decree.
(2) Faculty and staff serving at the National Defense Staff College, which is abolished upon enforcement of this Decree, may be appointed as faculty and staff of the Korea National Defense University within its authorized staffing quota.
(3) For faculty and staff appointed under paragraph (2), their grades and salary steps at the National Defense Staff College shall be recognized, and their appointment dates at that College shall be deemed their appointment dates at the Korea National Defense University.
Article 4 (Amendments of Other Decrees)
(1) The Enforcement Decree of the Military Personnel Management Act is amended as follows:
In Article 13 (1) 2 (a), “president of the National Defense Graduate School” is replaced by “president of the Korea National Defense University”.
In Article 15 (1) 2, “professor of the National Defense Graduate School” is replaced by “professor of the Korea National Defense University”, and “national security course” by “basic course”.
Subparagraph 2 of Article 16 is replaced by the following:
2. Professors and associate professors of the National Defense Graduate School shall be appointed by the President of the Republic through the Prime Minister upon recommendation by the Minister of National Defense with the consent of the Minister of Education; assistant professors shall be appointed by the Minister of National Defense upon recommendation by the president of the Korea National Defense University; full-time instructors shall be appointed by the president of the Korea National Defense University; and persons solely responsible for education in basic and special courses at the Korea National Defense University shall possess a qualification specified in any subparagraph of Article 13 of the Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Establishment of the Korea National Defense University.
In the main clause of subparagraph 2 of Article 17, “National Defense Graduate School” is replaced by “Korea National Defense University”, and “Article 6 (5) of the Act on the Establishment of the National Defense Graduate School” by “Article 9 (4) of the Act on the Establishment of the Korea National Defense University”; in the proviso to that subparagraph, “professors in charge of the national security course” is replaced by “professors solely responsible for education in basic and special courses”.
(2) The Decree on the Appointment of Police Officials is amended as follows: In Article 31 (2) 2, “National Defense Graduate School” is replaced by “Korea National Defense University”.
(3) The Public Officials Remuneration Regulations are amended as follows: In the column for officials to whom Table 12 applies in the classification of salary tables by type of public official in Table 1, “National Defense Graduate School” is replaced by “Korea National Defense University”.
(4) The Regulations on Allowances for Public Officials are amended as follows: In the columns for eligible recipients, amounts, and methods of payment in Table 11, “National Defense Graduate School” is replaced by “Korea National Defense University”, respectively.
(5) The Decree on the Appointment of Fire Officials is amended as follows: In Article 31 (1) 2, “National Defense Graduate School” is replaced by “Korea National Defense University”.
(6) The Decree on the Appointment of Foreign Service Officials is amended as follows: Subparagraph 4 of Article 19-2 (1) is replaced by the following:
4. Enrollment in a basic course or degree course of the Korea National Defense University.
